input: صور احترافية لعبوة عسل زجاجية لمتجر إلكتروني

data.prompt: A single glass jar of golden honey centered on a matte white pedestal, shot with a 85mm macro lens, soft top-down studio lighting creating subtle highlights on the glass, clean minimalist background, high-key aesthetic, sharp focus on the honey texture.
data.tip: استخدم هذا الخيار إذا كنت ترغب في إبراز تفاصيل قوام العسل بشكل نقي وواضح.

data.prompt: A glass honey jar placed on a dark grey slate surface, side-lit by a single softbox to emphasize the transparency of the glass and the amber glow of the honey, shot on a 50mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, moody and sophisticated atmosphere.
data.tip: اختر هذا الخيار لإعطاء طابع فخم وعصري لمنتجك في المتجر الإلكتروني.

data.prompt: A glass honey jar resting on a light oak wooden surface, natural morning light coming from the side, soft shadows, shot with a 35mm lens, wide framing to include negative space for branding, bright and airy composition, clean and organic feel.
